version_metadata.description:
NeuroCall is the premier operative neurosurgery reference atlas, crisis head CT interpretation workstation, and frontline emergency consultation manual designed for neurosurgeons, spine surgeons, neurocritical care teams, and surgical residents on call.

Featuring 42 high-definition photorealistic master plates, clarifying pathology schematics, and interactive diagnostic calipers, NeuroCall bridges operative microanatomy with rapid bedside clinical decision-making.

COMPREHENSIVE CLINICAL FEATURES:

• STUDIO-GRADE SURGICAL ATLAS (42 MASTER PLATES):
Organized into dedicated Cranial and Spine operative domains with 9 sub-specialty corridors. Each plate features high-magnification multi-touch zoom (1.0x to 5.0x), two-finger translation, pinned anatomical callouts, sequential surgical dissection steps, and catastrophic complication hazard alerts:

1. ANTERIOR & ANTEROLATERAL SKULL BASE (7 PLATES):
- Pterional Craniotomy & Sphenoid Ridge Osteotomy
- Distal Sylvian Fissure Microdissection
- Pterional Trans-Sylvian Microsurgical Anatomy
- Pterional PComA Aneurysm Clipping Corridor
- Frontotemporal Orbitozygomatic (FT-OZO) Two-Piece Approach
- Supraorbital Eyebrow Keyhole Craniotomy
- Endoscopic Endonasal Sellar / Pituitary Corridor

2. CRANIAL CONVEXITY, LOBAR & TRAUMA (5 PLATES):
- Bifrontal Craniotomy & Superior Sagittal Sinus Anatomy
- Temporal Craniotomy & Middle Meningeal Artery
- Parietal Craniotomy & Cortical Dural Mapping
- Decompressive Hemicraniectomy & Expansile Duraplasty
- Anterior Temporal Lobectomy (ATL) vs Selective Amygdalohippocampectomy

3. POSTERIOR FOSSA & LATERAL SKULL BASE (6 PLATES):
- Retromastoid Keyhole Positioning & Surface Landmarks
- Retrosigmoid Asterion & Transverse-Sigmoid Sinus Bony Window
- Retrosigmoid CPA Microdissection (CN VII/VIII/V)
- Midline Suboccipital Craniectomy & Cisterna Magna
- Far-Lateral Transcondylar Approach & V3 Vertebral Artery Mobilization
- Supracerebellar Infratentorial & Transtentorial Pineal Corridors

4. VASCULAR, VENTRICULAR & CRITICAL HEMORRHAGE (4 PLATES):
- Neonatal Anterior Fontanelle EVD Puncture & Trajectories
- Minimally Invasive Parafascicular Surgery (MIPS) / ICH Tubular Evacuation
- Aneurysmal Subarachnoid Hemorrhage (aSAH) Cisternal Anatomy
- Hypertensive Ganglionic ICH & Intraventricular Hemorrhage (IVH)

5. CRANIOVERTEBRAL JUNCTION (CVJ) & HIGH CERVICAL (4 PLATES):
- Craniocervical Junction (CCJ) Bony & Ligamentous Architecture
- Chiari I Malformation Decompression & Duraplasty
- Harms C1 Lateral Mass & C2 Pedicle/Pars Screw Fixation
- Odontoid Fractures Classification (Type I, II, III) & Biomechanics

6. CERVICAL SPINE (ANTERIOR & POSTERIOR) (4 PLATES):
- Anterior Cervical Discectomy & Fusion (ACDF) Surgical Corridor
- Posterior Cervical Laminectomy, Lateral Mass Screws & Fusion
- Bilateral Jumped / Locked Cervical Facets Reduction
- Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy (OPLL / Cord Compression)

7. THORACIC SPINE & SPINAL ONCOLOGY (3 PLATES):
- Thoracic Costotransversectomy & Extracavitary Corridor
- Thoracolumbar Burst Fracture & Canal Retropulsion
- Metastatic Epidural Spinal Cord Compression (MESCC / Bilsky Scale)

8. LUMBAR DEGENERATIVE, STENOSIS & MIS CORRIDORS (6 PLATES):
- Lumbar Disc Herniation, Annular Tear & Root Compression
- Lumbar Lateral Recess Stenosis & Trefoil Canal Anatomy
- Massive Central Lumbar Disc Extrusion & Cauda Equina Syndrome
- Transforaminal Lumbar Interbody Fusion (TLIF) Kambin's Triangle Corridor
- Lateral Lumbar Interbody Fusion (LLIF) Transpsoas Corridor & Plexus
- 360° Circumferential Lumbar Interbody Fusion Approaches (ALIF/LLIF/TLIF/PLIF)

9. COMPLEX SPINAL DEFORMITY & DURAL SALVAGE (3 PLATES):
- Smith-Petersen (SPO) & Ponte Posterior Column Osteotomies
- Pedicle Subtraction Osteotomy (PSO) Three-Column Realignment
- Postoperative Lumbar Pseudomeningocele & Complex Dural Repair

• CLARIFYING PATHOLOGY SCHEMATICS FOR RESIDENTS:
High-yield cross-sectional schematics clarifying acute surgical pathologies to accelerate diagnostic recognition, anatomical orientation, and operative case preparation for neurosurgery and spine residents on call.

• 2 AM CRISIS HEAD CT WORKSTATION:
Standardized calvarium calipers and diagnostic checklists for acute epidural hematoma (EDH), acute subdural hematoma (SDH), uncal herniation, and posterior fossa hemorrhage.

• FRONTLINE ER CONSULTS & 4-PHASE TRIAGE PROTOCOLS:
Actionable first-hour emergency order sets, operative indications, and clinical decision algorithms for acute intracranial hemorrhage, shunt malfunction tap dynamics, cervical facet dislocations, cauda equina syndrome, and spinal cord injury.

• RAPID CLINICAL CALCULATORS:
Deterministic, literature-grounded risk scoring for Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS), Spetzler-Martin, Hunt & Hess, Modified Fisher, ICH Score, and ASIA Spinal Impairment.

CLINICAL REFERENCE DISCLAIMER:
NeuroCall is designed strictly as an educational and rapid bedside reference tool for neurosurgeons, spine surgeons, neurocritical care teams, and surgical residents on call. Calculations, hematoma volume approximations, and risk stratification scores are clinical decision-support aids that do not replace independent clinical acumen, physical examination, and professional medical judgment.

Engineered for instantaneous bedside execution with zero ads, zero user tracking, and full offline accessibility.

app_review_information.review_notes:
Dear Apple App Review Team,

NeuroCall is an institutional operative neurosurgery reference atlas, crisis head CT workstation, and frontline emergency consultation manual engineered from scratch by Dr. A. Alex Mohit, MD, PhD (practicing neurosurgeon and spine surgeon, developer of PJKPredict, ID 6738947265, currently live in the Medical category).

KEY REVIEW DETAILS:
1. TARGET AUDIENCE: Designed exclusively as an operative reference and educational training workstation for neurosurgeons, spine surgeons, neurocritical care teams, and surgical residents/fellows on call.
2. CLARIFYING PATHOLOGY PLATES FOR RESIDENTS: In addition to 42 high-definition master operative corridors, NeuroCall includes specialized cross-sectional pathology schematics (e.g. lumbar lateral recess stenosis, epidural cord compression, annular tear root displacement, acute herniation vectors) to provide clarifying anatomical correlation for surgical residents during acute consult triage.
3. ZERO SIGN-IN / INSTANT ACCESSIBILITY: The application requires zero login, zero external credentials, zero subscriptions, and zero internet connection to evaluate. All 42 plates, crisis head CT checklists, and calculators function 100% offline immediately upon first launch.
4. HIPAA & PRIVACY COMPLIANCE: NeuroCall collects zero personal or patient health information (PHI). No user data is ever transmitted off the device.
5. CLINICAL GROUNDING: All emergency protocols, hematoma evacuation guidelines, and clinical calculators (GCS, Hunt & Hess, Spetzler-Martin, ICH Score, ASIA) are derived strictly from established, peer-reviewed medical literature (Brain Trauma Foundation, AHA/ASA, and AANS guidelines).

Thank you for your review,
Alex Mohit, MD, PhD
Department of Neurological Surgery
